question.text: PPM Section IX (Conflicts of Interest) must disclose conflicts arising at multiple levels. Which of the following is NOT a level expressly enumerated in Chapter 9 Box 9.1?

answer.text: At the level of employee of the management entity
At the level of service providers of the Fund/Scheme
At the level of members of various governance bodies
At the level of the investor's spouse's employer

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5 Box 9.1 Section IX lists conflict levels: employee of management entity, service providers, Manager, Sponsor, Investor, members of governance bodies, Sponsor/Manager group entity across various schemes. Warehousing and co-investment disclosures are also covered. The investor's spouse's employer is not an enumerated level. The Trap: Distractors A, B, C are verbatim. Option D over-extends personal-relationship disclosure, an intuitive but wrong extension. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C lists the same conflict-of-interest levels. XXI-B PMS regulations separately require conflict disclosure; similar spirit. Manager's Pro-Tip: Beyond the template, add conflicts specific to YOUR Cat III strategy — e.g., if the Manager also runs a PMS pooling similar longs, spell out the order-allocation policy clearly in Section IX.
